description: T-4130: does Excel for the web open and apply each value filter and Top-N type of a pivot? The data are t4130-pivot-label-filters' (Product sums Apple 30, Apricot 4, Banana 12, Cherry 11, Grape 6, total 63). Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Product, Sum of Sales, with one `<filter fld="1" iMeasureFld="0">`: VEq valueEqual 12; VNe valueNotEqual 12; VGt valueGreaterThan 11; VGe valueGreaterThanOrEqual 11; VLt valueLessThan 11; VLe valueLessThanOrEqual 11; VBt valueBetween 6 and 12; VNbt valueNotBetween 6 and 12; TC count top 2; TB count bottom 2 (top10 top 0); TP percent top 50; TS sum top 40; TCv count top 2 with a stale filterVal 999; VM1 valueGreaterThan 1 on the second data field (Count of Sales, iMeasureFld 1). Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
